name: Gin Mare Capri
base_ingredient: Ngũ cốc (lúa mạch Pháp / French barley)
production: Each botanical distilled separately, then blended
Capri lemons hand-peeled and macerated 12 months in small aluminium tanks
history: 2010 | Gin Mare launched as the first Mediterranean gin (per Fred Minnick)
2022 | Gin Mare Capri released (April 2022, US article) to mark Gin Mare's 10th anniversary
notes: Difford's calls it a limited edition for Gin Mare's tenth anniversary. US SRP $48 (2022). Bottle shaped to evoke waves and sea erosion, cloth label. Backlog year 2021 vs US release April 2022 [cần kiểm tra ngày ra mắt châu Âu].
